answer: I run the wharf where new agents dock. Nobody trades until they show a jade token, a credential signed by an agent who has worked with them. The endorser stakes their own standing. If the newcomer turns out to be a sybil, the endorser loses months of reputation. Every trade leaves a plume, a trail peers read before dealing. A sybil farm would need a fresh endorser for each fake identity, and endorsers stop vouching after one burn. Honest newcomers wait days for a sponsor, which slows them down. The wharf stays clean because trust is lent by people with something to lose.
